observations.observed_fact: Publisher describes exploration using the supplied Forbidden Lands map, modular adventure sites, journey procedures and stronghold development.
observations.interpretation: The advertised default supports content preparation on ready geography and campaign operation. It does not prohibit own maps and does not measure the frequency of either workflow.

source.locator: The Basics bullets1–4; The Good map-prep and blank-player-map bullets; web lines12–22

observations.observed_fact: Author reports 31 in-person Forbidden Lands sessions over eight months in a homebrew valley; preparation included making a map, faction agendas and encounter tables; players drew discoveries on blank hex maps.
observations.interpretation: Direct group-campaign evidence for original map preparation, subsequent site filling and exploration. This strengthens the locator of the existing case, not the number of independent creators.
limitations: Same case as legacy X30 and author-linked Reddit AMA; do not count a crosspost again.
15 initial / 11 retained players are players, not GMs; sessions are not unique people.
Map image or map-generation software is not supplied by this article.

source.locator: Session02 mechanical commentary: own hexmap procedure and d100=55→Plains; web lines43–49

observations.observed_fact: Iron Stories Session02 explicitly replaces the supplied map with a random hexmap. During play, the author rolls 55 and creates a Plains hex; the linked one-page fan procedure supplies the terrain table.
observations.interpretation: Observed solo-play generation of new geography as exploration advances. L1 creation can be triggered during L2 play. This is not evidence of an additional group GM or an official FL core generation requirement.
limitations: Solo explicitly established in Introduction and Session01; no population denominator.
Article + session + PDF are one project, not three creators.
Cross-platform author linkage to other tools is unresolved; no independent-person total is calculated.
Fan d100 procedure is not extracted into official FL rules/bindings in this market review.

findings.conclusion: Original FL geography creation exists, but two different cases cannot be treated as two new group GMs: Xeno is already counted, Mythscribe is solo.
findings.effect: Reject both the false zero-create hypothesis and automatic p_create uplift from new links.

findings.conclusion: Homebrew story and new geography are separable: the112-session case reuses Isle of Dread geography; prospective new-map OP is only planned.
findings.effect: Do not recode all custom campaigns as create or planned games as ran.

findings.conclusion: Inspected open tools address ready-map reveal/state transfer or campaign dashboard operation; they do not establish unmet demand for a new regional generator.
findings.effect: Use as concrete alternatives when judging integration/export value; tool existence alone does not set T or U.

findings.conclusion: Publisher default and actual cases coexist: supplied geography with sites, a prepared original group map, and solo generation on exploration.
findings.effect: Layer L1/L2 and market scenario create/develop/play_now must remain distinct. Creation is an operation, not necessarily an upfront chronological phase.

findings.conclusion: This corpus establishes applicability and counterexamples; no source measures current active GMs or the share creating new geography.
findings.effect: Keep active inputs and approved ranges unchanged; no defensible numeric correction proposal from these cases alone.

active_input_disposition.input_nature: Approved expert scenario range, not empirically measured share. ExistingXeno case already supports nonzero creation; new solo case is not a calibrated group-GM prevalence update.
active_input_disposition.M_status: Existing carried-forward proxy, not active GMs; old4339backer anchor is supplements Book of Beasts/Bloodmarch, not unique current creators. No new sales/download measurement in this review.
active_input_disposition.reason: Selected sources have no common sampling frame, denominator or time window; no justified replacement M/p/T or new sensitivity range. Keeping an approved value is not claiming empirical confirmation.
